messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: How do I include my own javascript files?
parts:
Do NOT put your own files into the www/shared folder! Your files will be deleted whenever you upgrade the Shiny package.

Instead, create a www directory in your own application folder, and copy the JS/CSS files there; for example, www/highcharts/js/highcharts.js will automatically be made available at the relative URL "highcharts/js/highcharts.js" (note the lack of "www" in the URL).


On Sun, Aug 18, 2013 at 7:55 AM, Zhuo Jia Dai <zhuoj...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi,

I had switched to using HTML as it more flexible than UI.R. However when I switched I noticed that the rChart plot stop. After searching the net for a bit and reading some JavaScript books I checked the console in Chrome and noticed that it complained about some highcharts.js being missing. So I manually copied the highcharts folder that contained the highcarts.js into the R folder contains the shiny packages www/shared/highcharts. And everythignn worked after that.

Now I want to include my own Javascript file, so I thought I just copy into the www/shared folder within the shiny package folder then I am fine. However this doesn't seem to work. What do I need to do?

Say my html file looks like below

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=windows-1252"/>
  <!-- the script files are files located in R folder e.g. \R-2.15.3\library\shiny\www\shared -->
  <link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="shared/shiny.css"/>
  <link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="shared/slider/css/jquery.slider.min.css"/>
  <link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="shared/bootstrap/css/bootstrap.min.css"/>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
  <link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="shared/bootstrap/css/bootstrap-responsive.min.css"/>
  <title>AnalytixWare CloudScorer</title>
  <!-- I renamed the tablecloth library to the following library -->
  <link href="shared/tablecloth/assets/css/tablecloth.css" rel="stylesheet" />
</head>
<body>



  <script src="shared/jquery.js" type="text/javascript"></script>
  <script src="shared/bootstrap/js/bootstrap.min.js"></script>
  <script scr="shared/tablecloth/assets/js/jquery.metadata.js"></script>
  <script scr="shared/tablecloth/assets/js/jquery.tablesorter.min.js"></script>  

  <script scr="shared/tablecloth/assets/js/jquery.tablecloth.js"></script>

  <script src="shared/slider/js/jquery.slider.min.js"></script>  
   <script src="shared/shiny.js" type="text/javascript"></script>

   <script src="shared/highcharts/js/highcharts.js" type="text/javascript"></script>
   <script src="shared/highcharts/js/highcharts-more.js" type="text/javascript"></script>

<script scr="shared/hello.js"></script>

</body>
</html>

and my hello.js file is a simple

console.log("please help")

So I changed the jquery.js file and added a console.log("this is working") to the end of it and it printed to the log fine. So I assume when I call runApp from R, the shiny code actually copies the jquery.js to some folder. But it does not copy hello.js. HOw do I make it copy hello.js to the server folder as well?

--
